t: 克里斯蒂安二世被迫退位丹麦和挪威国王。
te: Christian II is forced to abdicate as King of Denmark and Norway.
dz: 克里斯蒂安二世被迫退位丹麦和挪威国王。
de: Christian II is forced to abdicate as King of Denmark and Norway.

t: 瑞典摄政古斯塔夫·瓦萨被选为瑞典国王,并标志着卡尔马联盟的象征性结束,6月6日被定为国家国庆日.
te: Swedish regent Gustav Vasa is elected King of Sweden and, marking a symbolic end to the Kalmar Union, 6 June is designa…
dz: 瑞典摄政古斯塔夫·瓦萨被选为瑞典国王,并标志着卡尔马联盟的象征性结束,6月6日被定为国家国庆日.
de: Swedish regent Gustav Vasa is elected King of Sweden and, marking a symbolic end to the Kalmar Union, 6 June is designated the country's national day.
